topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The place where I found the best warmth, the truest comfort, is going to be just a memory. I keep thinking of the last time I was there, the way the light fell and made it all feel right. It’s hard to think about it not being there anymore, the silence where the laughter used to be, the empty space where the tables once stood. I try to hold onto the taste, the smells, but they’re fading, like old leaves in the wind. I know I should find a new spot, but it’s not the same. It’s never the same.
